evidence: Films are characterized by spectroscopic ellipsometry, atomic force microscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and far ultraviolet reflectometry. The morphology of the resulting films was investigated by atomic force microscopy (AFM). Film composition was studied by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The measured FUV reflectance of LiF deposited on Si substrates indicated an aging effect... near-normal reﬂectance measurements.
